visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with short hair and a white halter top is filmed in a low-light environment, her face illuminated by a strong red glow. She has a wide-eyed, emotional expression with her mouth slightly open. (2) Footage on a large concert screen shows several female performers in stylized red and black outfits dancing dynamically on a stage with bursts of orange fire in the foreground. (3) The first woman reappears, screaming with excitement, her face scrunched in joy while holding a pink heart-shaped lightstick in a crowded, dark venue. (4) Wide shot of the concert stage featuring four performers and multiple backup dancers moving in synchronization under bright purple spotlights and pyrotechnic effects. (5) A close-up on the screen shows a blonde performer drinking from a yellow plastic cup with a straw while sitting in a backstage or transit area. (6) The blonde performer is seen on stage in a dark dress, holding a pink microphone and gesturing toward a massive audience filled with glowing lights. (7) A sequence of fast cuts shows the performers in various outfits, including green laser light effects cutting across the stage and dancers in white performing complex choreography. (8) The performers stand together at the front of the stage, waving and bowing to the crowd, while white confetti or snow-like effects fall from above. (9) The camera pans across a massive outdoor stadium at night, filled with thousands of fans holding glowing pink lightsticks as large fireworks explode in the sky above the stage structure. (10) The four performers stand center stage in casual concert merchandise, laughing and gesturing toward the camera as the scene fades into a wide view of the illuminated arena.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) High-intensity crowd screaming and cheering blends with loud, beat-driven electronic pop music. A female voice shouts with high arousal. (2) Melodic female singing starts, characterized by a bright vocal timbre and high pitch, layered over a driving 4/4 drum beat and synthesizer chords. (3) A sharp 'whoosh' sound from pyrotechnics is followed by a surge in crowd volume. The lead vocal continues a high-tempo melodic line. (4) Music volume ducks slightly for a spoken interaction; a female voice speaks English with a friendly, professional tone and rising intonation. (5) Multiple female voices harmonize in a rhythmic chant while heavy electronic bass and percussive claps dominate the mix. (6) Sudden high-frequency cracking sounds of fireworks occur over the fading music track, followed by loud sustained applause and collective cheering.
